costNote: Reported usage with dated list-price estimates where configured. Jev uses account-owner pricing supplied 2026-09-17: $0.04/M input, free output. Average cost divides known cost by priced requests; failed/canceled calls are excluded and may still be billed.
timingNote: Scene measurement excludes the 1.2-second slideshow transition; driving playtime comes from its monotonic 10-second engine clock.
